summary: Sets the radius (reach) of a light entry in the court scene editor.
details: Vanilla fires it when the radius value changes in the editor (the GUI event onvaluechanged).

fields.name: light
fields.text: The light entry to change.

label: Set camera shadow fade
summary: Sets the shadow fade value of a camera entry in the court scene editor.
details: Vanilla fires it when the shadow fade value changes in the editor (the GUI event onvaluechanged).

fields.name: camera
fields.text: The camera entry to change.

label: Set shadows fade
summary: Sets the shadows fade value, which is not tied to one camera or light entry, in the court scene editor.
details: Vanilla fires it when the shadows fade value changes in the editor (the GUI event onvaluechanged). It takes no argument, unlike OnSetShadowFade and SetShadowFade, which get a camera entry; what it belongs to beyond that rests on the name.

label: Set shadows strength
summary: Sets the shadows strength value, which is not tied to one camera or light entry, in the court scene editor.
details: Vanilla fires it when the shadows strength value changes in the editor (the GUI event onvaluechanged). It takes no argument, unlike OnSetShadowFade and SetShadowFade, which get a camera entry; what it belongs to beyond that rests on the name.

label: Set camera yaw
summary: Sets the yaw (turn left or right) of a camera entry in the court scene editor.
details: Vanilla fires it when the yaw value changes in the editor (the GUI event onvaluechanged).

fields.name: camera
fields.text: The camera entry to change.

label: Showing artifact debug lines
summary: Whether the editor currently draws debug lines for artifacts.
details: Vanilla uses it as the checked state of a checkbox, paired with ToggleArtifactDebugLines which flips it.

label: Showing asset debug lines
summary: Whether the editor currently draws debug lines for assets.
details: Vanilla uses it as the checked state of a checkbox, paired with ToggleAssetsDebugLines which flips it.

label: Showing character debug lines
summary: Whether the editor currently draws debug lines for characters.
details: Vanilla uses it as the checked state of a checkbox, paired with ToggleCharacterDebugLines which flips it.

label: Showing selection debug lines
summary: Whether the editor currently draws debug lines for the selection.
details: Vanilla uses it as the checked state of a checkbox, paired with ToggleSelectionDebugLines which flips it.

label: Toggle animated light
summary: Switches a light entry between flickering (animated) and steady.
details: Vanilla calls it from a checkbox-style button on the light entry; its tooltip says it makes the light flicker and shows the animation controls.

fields.name: light
fields.text: The light entry to change.

label: Toggle idle camera animation
summary: Switches the idle camera animation on or off in the court scene editor.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button click; its tooltip says "Animate idle camera".

label: Toggle camera transition animation
summary: Switches animated transitions between cameras on or off in the court scene editor.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button click; its tooltip says "Use animated transitions between cameras".

label: Toggle artifact debug lines
summary: Switches the debug lines for artifacts on or off in the court scene editor.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button click; ShowArtifactDebugLines reports the state.

label: Toggle artifact expanded
summary: Going by its name, opens or closes the detail section of an artifact entry in the court scene editor list.
details: Vanilla calls it from an expand button on that entry in the artifact list. Its exact effect rests on the name.

fields.name: artifact
fields.text: The artifact entry to expand or collapse.

label: Toggle asset expanded
summary: Going by its name, opens or closes the detail section of an asset entry in the court scene editor list.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button click on that entry. Its exact effect rests on the name.

fields.name: asset
fields.text: The asset entry to expand or collapse.

label: Toggle asset debug lines
summary: Switches the debug lines for assets on or off in the court scene editor.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button click; ShowAssetsDebugLines reports the state.

label: Toggle camera expanded
summary: Going by its name, opens or closes the detail section of a camera entry in the court scene editor list.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button click on that entry. Its exact effect rests on the name.

fields.name: camera
fields.text: The camera entry to expand or collapse.

label: Toggle screenshot camera
summary: Marks or unmarks a camera entry as the one used to take screenshots.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button on that camera; its tooltip says "Use the camera to take screenshots".

fields.name: camera
fields.text: The camera entry to change.

label: Toggle character debug lines
summary: Switches the debug lines for characters on or off in the court scene editor.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button click; ShowCharacterDebugLines reports the state.

label: Toggle character expanded
summary: Going by its name, opens or closes the detail section of a character entry in the court scene editor list.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button click on that entry. Its exact effect rests on the name.

fields.name: character
fields.text: The character entry to expand or collapse.

label: Toggle cubemap shadow
summary: Switches a light entry between normal and omnidirectional (all-around) shadows.
details: Vanilla calls it from a checkbox-style button on the light entry; its tooltip says "Make this light source use omnidirectional shadows". The button is enabled only while the light casts shadows (IsAffectedByShadow).

fields.name: light
fields.text: The light entry to change.

label: Toggle light casts shadow
summary: Switches whether a light entry casts shadows.
details: Vanilla calls it from a checkbox-style button labelled "Cast shadow"; its tooltip says "Make this light source cast shadows".

fields.name: light
fields.text: The light entry to change.

label: Toggle light enabled
summary: Switches a light entry on or off in the court scene editor.
details: Vanilla calls it from a checkbox-style button on the light entry; its tooltip says "Toggle this light".

fields.name: light
fields.text: The light entry to switch.

label: Toggle light expanded
summary: Going by its name, opens or closes the detail section of a light entry in the court scene editor list.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button click on that entry. Its exact effect rests on the name.

fields.name: light
fields.text: The light entry to expand or collapse.

label: Toggle selection debug lines
summary: Switches the debug lines for the selection on or off in the court scene editor.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button click; ShowSelectionDebugLines reports the state.

label: Toggle shadow camera display
summary: Switches the drawing of a light entry's shadow camera volume on or off in the court scene editor.
details: Vanilla calls it from a checkbox-style button on the light entry; its tooltip says "Draw shadow camera volume. Only available when shadow is active". The button is enabled only while the light casts shadows.

fields.name: light
fields.text: The light entry it applies to.

label: Toggle light debug widget
summary: Switches the debug widget of a light entry on or off in the court scene editor.
details: Vanilla calls it from a checkbox-style button labelled "Toggle debug widget"; its tooltip says "Toggle debug widges for light sources" (spelled so in the game).

fields.name: light
fields.text: The light entry it applies to.

label: Toggle tools editor
summary: Switches the editor's interactive scene tools on or off.
details: Vanilla calls it from the button "Toggle tools"; its tooltip says "Toggle interactive scene editor tools".

label: Undo
summary: Undoes the last change in the court scene editor.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button with the tooltip "Undo change", enabled by CanUndo. It is the counterpart of RedoCommand.

label: Scene settings (editable)
summary: Gives access to the court scene settings object itself, in a form that can be changed.
details: The game documents no description. The name has the form of the Access variants other types have, which hand on the object for editing; the court editor passes such values to its edit functions.

label: Visual culture
summary: The visual culture the court scene settings belong to, as text.
details: Vanilla shows it in the editor next to the label "Visual culture:", taken from the active settings of the court scene editor.

label: Scene settings
summary: The court scene settings object itself.
details: The game documents no description. Vanilla passes it to GetSceneSettingsName to show a settings name in text and tooltips.

label: Task item (editable)
summary: Gives access to the court task interaction item itself, in a form that can be changed.
details: The game documents no description. The name has the form of the Access variants other types have, which hand on the object itself.

label: Court position
summary: The court position this item in the court task interaction window stands for.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a part of the window. The return type is not registered, so what it is exactly rests on the name.

label: Select task item
summary: Selects this item in the court task interaction window.
details: Vanilla calls it from a click on an item. Going by the name, the window then treats its court position as the chosen one.

label: Task item
summary: The court task interaction item itself.
details: The game documents no description. Other types use their Self function to hand the object itself on.

label: Court positions list
summary: The list of court positions shown in the court task interaction window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data model of a list in the window. The return type is not registered, so the exact kind of entries rests on the name.

label: Task window (editable)
summary: Gives access to the court task interaction window itself, in a form that can be changed.
details: The game documents no description. The name has the form of the Access variants other types have, which hand on the object itself.

label: Can send offer
summary: Whether the offer made in the court task interaction window can be sent now.
details: Vanilla uses it as the enabled state of the send button, with GetSendOfferTooltip as the button tooltip.

label: Close window
summary: Closes the court task interaction window.
details: Vanilla calls it from a close button click.

label: Confirmation window
summary: The confirmation window that belongs to the court task interaction.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a part of the window. The return type is not registered, so what it holds exactly rests on the name.

label: Selected court position
summary: The court position currently selected in the court task interaction window.
details: Vanilla compares each court position in the list with it to mark the selected one, and shows its name in the text "Selected Position: ...".

label: Selected position header
summary: Going by its name, the header text for the selected court position in the court task interaction window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the text of a label in the window.

label: Send offer tooltip
summary: The tooltip text of the send button in the court task interaction window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the tooltip of the button whose enabled state is CanSendOffer. Going by the name, it likely explains why sending is or is not possible.

label: Has selected position
summary: Whether a court position is currently selected in the court task interaction window.
details: Vanilla uses it, and its negation, to show or hide parts of the window.

label: Select court position
summary: Selects a court position in the court task interaction window.
details: The game's own files do not use it, so the argument is not shown. Going by the name, it takes the court position to select.

fields.name: position
fields.text: Probably the court position to select; the game documents no meaning.

label: Task window
summary: The court task interaction window itself.
details: The game documents no description. Other types use their Self function to hand the object itself on.

label: Send offer
summary: Sends the offer made in the court task interaction window.
details: Vanilla calls it from the send button click; the button is enabled only while CanSendOffer holds.

label: Toolset (editable)
summary: Gives access to the court toolset object itself, in a form that can be changed.
details: The game documents no description. The name has the form of the Access variants other types have, which hand on the object itself.

label: Is rotation mode
summary: Whether the court scene editor's tool is in rotation mode.
details: Vanilla uses it as the checked state of a toolbar button, with SetModeRotation as its click.

label: Is scale mode
summary: Whether the court scene editor's tool is in scale mode.
details: Vanilla uses it as the checked state of a toolbar button, with SetModeScale as its click.

label: Is select mode
summary: Whether the court scene editor's tool is in select mode.
details: Vanilla uses it as the checked state of a toolbar button, with SetModeSelect as its click.

label: Is move mode
summary: Whether the court scene editor's tool is in translate (move) mode.
details: Vanilla uses it as the checked state of a toolbar button. The input shows no matching SetModeTranslate use.

label: Toolset
summary: The court toolset object itself.
details: The game documents no description. Other types use their Self function to hand the object itself on.

label: Set rotation mode
summary: Puts the court scene editor's tool into rotation mode.
details: Vanilla calls it from a toolbar button click; IsModeRotation reports the state.

label: Set scale mode
summary: Puts the court scene editor's tool into scale mode.
details: Vanilla calls it from a toolbar button click; IsModeScale reports the state.

label: Set select mode
summary: Puts the court scene editor's tool into select mode.
details: Vanilla calls it from a toolbar button click; IsModeSelect reports the state.
